findings.title: Alerts are overwritten even when a person changed them by hand, which ticket criterion 2 forbids
findings.why_it_matters: Dashboards are skipped when their source is not "pack", but every alert of the pack is upserted, and alerts.upsert in db.ts replaces metric and threshold on conflict. A threshold a customer tuned on an alert with a pack key is reset on every run of the loader.
findings.suggested_fix: Read the alert first with tx.alerts.findByKey and keep it when its source is not "pack", as the dashboards loop does, and report it in the summary.
